profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm currently a software engineer working in cloud security at Google, based in New York City.

My team's work involves building robust security solutions for local cloud, an increasingly important infrastructure setup-use case for companies, organizations and countries around the world.

Every day I'm filled with gratitude at the opportunity to work with the fun and amazing people on mine and neighboring teams in NY, and I also don't kid myself about how lucky we are to work on the frontier of a nascent field of cloud tech and apply engineering creativity to tough challenges.

Prior to working in tech I've also been fortunate to live and work in East Asia for over 3 years where I made a bunch of friends and lived several lifetimes of adventures with them.

Feel free to reach out.


GitHub: https://github.com/adrianlee0118
LeetCode: adrianlee0118 (Competing for fun since 2019)

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Develop backend infrastructure assets for key and secrets management across all Google applications as member of Keystore team
• Own workstream to build emergency encryption key rotation global workflow engine
• Engineering excellence in C++codebase for efficiency, memory management, readability
• Participation in project roadmap development and ideating new features

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain assets for AWS Marketplace Seller Settings Portal 
• Designed and developed scalable solutions with the AWS stack, including services such as Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, SNS, SQS, Elastic Load Balancer, CloudFormation, etc.
• Built and managed full CI/CD pipelines including code coverage checks, integration tests, and other validations as well as set up monitors and alarms
• Led integration tests framework migration to accommodate large-scale UI upgrades and also introduce headless browser UI testing, successfully deprecating all V1 tests without loss of coverage or canary downtime
• Led development on and successfully shipped a major EU seller compliance audit job project (see Projects)
• On-call rotations responding to issues on team-owned packages 
• 1st on the team of 14 (including SDEIIs and SDEIIIs) for delivered code in 2022 
• Success stories for reducing team API latency by 40% and for team docs revamp

honors.title: APEGBC Municipal Engineers Division (Curtis Memorial) Award in Civil Engineering
honors.description: Award is offered by the Municipal Engineers Division of the Association of Professional Engineers and Geoscientists of BC in memory of Bill Curtis, a graduate of the University of Alberta and a prominent civil engineer who worked for the City of Vancouver from 1956 to 1992, serving as City Engineer from 1974 until his retirement. The award is given to a student entering fourth year. Candidates must have achieved excellent academic standing and have demonstrated interest in municipal engineering, and participate in extra-curricular activities and student service organizations. The award is made on the recommendation of the Department of Civil Engineering.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Remedying the pervasive general state of misinformation which serves as a basis for negative perceptional bias towards fields of engineering in undergraduate students, particularly those who are choosing their major.

I tell people about the benefits and drawbacks of becoming an engineering student and also try to lend some foresight to new university students in consideration of future vocation.

If you are an undergrad and you want to learn more about engineering school, message me!!
General support for club events including regional judo tournaments, club barbecues, community exhibitions, Salmon Festival booth, general help at Steveston Community Centre.

projects.title: AWS Marketplace Seller Settings Portal Audit Workflows
projects.description:
• Project continuously audits financial data alignment across multiple dependency services for 40,000+ production seller accounts
• Composition of AWS stack serverless and monitoring components (i.e. Lambdas, Step Functions, Event Rules, CloudWatch logging, S3 etc.) via SDK using TypeScript, Java
• In addition to meeting business use case, optimized to meet SLAs and fit logically within on-call cycle 
• Driven by myself from requirements gathering to development and ship, involving communication, understanding business use case/EU regulations, research/coding in AWS SDK, E2E test coverage, load testing, deployment monitoring, writing SOP

projects.title: Structify
projects.description:
• App that takes scheduling inputs from a dynamically-generated GUI to generate a custom
calendar-form visual representation of calculated outputs that can be imported to Google Calendar
• Uses asynchronous techniques to compartmentalize Google API functions and maintain UI integrity
